verdict.rationale: mise is itself an official CLI with a full documented command reference, global flags such as `-C`, machine-friendly options like `--dry-run --json`, and a `mise mcp` subcommand that exposes the CLI's project context to AI assistants. An llms.txt is also served, and community users report everyday CLI use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI being driven by AI agents specifically, beyond first-party docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: `-C --cd <DIR>` — Run as if mise were started in DIR
`mise mcp` runs a Model Context Protocol server that lets an AI assistant read a project's tools, tasks, environment variables and config files, and run its tasks.
Dev tools, env vars, and tasks in one CLI
